title: Embeddings of Generalized Weighted Morrey Spaces
summary: We study continuous embeddings from two classes of generalized weighted Morrey spaces into generalized Morrey spaces. The Komori--Shirai-type spaces use the weighted measure of cubes in their normalization, whereas the Samko-type spaces use the Lebesgue measure. We first consider generalized Morrey spaces on bounded domains. In the non-radial setting, we establish embedding results under local radial comparability assumptions on the Morrey functions.
